# STACKIT

Use `stackit/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "stackit-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "stackit/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct-FP8",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `STACKIT_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://api.openai-compat.model-serving.eu01.onstackit.cloud/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `STACKIT_BASE_URL`.
